coal.trend_notes: Coal output fell 5.8% year-on-year in April 2026. Structural headwinds from global energy transition, ESG-driven capital withdrawal, and reduced Eskom demand as renewables scale. Richards Bay Coal Terminal export market active but under price and volume pressure. Waterberg coalfields (Limpopo) remain a long-term strategic reserve with slower development. Domestic power generation remains the stabilising demand floor.
key_regions: Mpumalanga (Witbank/eMalahleni, Middelburg, Secunda, Ogies — ~80% of SA coal output; key mines: Eskom-contracted collieries, AEMFC Vlakfontein, Glencore R554, Thungela)
Limpopo (Waterberg coalfields — Medupi/Kusile supply, long-term strategic reserve)

chrome.trend_notes: Chromium production +37.3% in January 2026; +3.9% for full year 2025. South Africa holds world's largest chrome reserves. Demand driven by robust global stainless steel demand from post-pandemic manufacturing recovery (China, India). Battery electric vehicle and green energy applications creating emerging demand. Steelpoort valley and Bushveld Complex in strong growth mode.
key_regions: Limpopo (Steelpoort valley — primary chrome belt; Bushveld Igneous Complex, Glencore Rhovan/Rhein)
North West (western limb Bushveld; Brits-Rustenburg corridor)

iron_ore.demand_trend: Stable to slight decline with premium-grade upgrade investment
iron_ore.trend_notes: Iron ore production decreased 1.9% in 2026, linked to reduced Chinese steel output (down 4% in 2025). However, Kumba Iron Ore (Anglo American) executing R11.2bn Sishen Ultra-High Dense Media Separation (UHD-MS) project — increasing premium proportion from 18% to 55% of output. Construction commenced November 2024; initial operations expected 2026. Capital upgrade creates significant equipment demand even as total volumes are under pressure.
key_regions: Northern Cape (Sishen Mine and Khumani Mine, Kathu — 95%+ of SA iron ore production; Kumba and Assmang)

Ivanhoe Mines / Mototolo joint venture: $488M Phase 1 + $1.5bn Phase 2 for Turfspruit and Macalacaskop expansion. Sibanye-Stillwater active in equipment and services procurement (loading and hauling RFI confirmed June 2026). Valterra Platinum (fmr. Amplats) using SAP Ariba for supplier procurement.

gold.trend_notes: Gold sales +12.2% to R19.5bn underpinned by record gold prices (above $3,000/oz in 2026). Qala Shallows Gold Mine (West Wits Mining, Witwatersrand) opened late 2025 — first new underground gold mine in SA in 15 years. Targeting 70,000oz/year. Phase of larger Witwatersrand Basin Project. TGME gold mine project: revised feasibility February 2026, 13.1-year life-of-mine plan covering Beta, Rietfontein, CDM and Frankfort. High gold price incentivising marginal mine re-openings and junior miner development.

North West (Carletonville district — deepest mines, AngloGold, Harmony)

primary_legislation.act: Mine Health and Safety Act No. 29 of 1996 (MHSA)
primary_legislation.authority: Department of Mineral Resources and Energy (DMRE) — Mine Health and Safety Inspectorate
key_obligations: Equipment owners supplying to mines: all plant must be safe and compliant before delivery to site
Machinery in hazardous areas (underground) must be explosion-protected and certified by SANAS-accredited test laboratory (ATL certificate required)
Risk assessments required for all equipment entering mine premises
Owners of equipment deployed at mines share duty-of-care obligations with the mine employer
2024 MHSA amendments: penalties up to 10% of annual turnover for non-compliance
Covers ventilation, ground control, explosives and machinery regulations in detail

primary_legislation.act: Occupational Health and Safety Act No. 85 of 1993 (OHS Act)
key_obligations: Applies to equipment used in non-mining workplaces (construction sites, workshops, depots, transport yards)
24 subsidiary regulations form part of the OHS Act framework
Construction Regulations (GNR 84 of 2014): apply when equipment used on construction sites
General Machinery Regulations: equipment must be inspected, maintained and certified as safe
Driven Machinery Regulations: earthmoving and powered vehicles require periodic inspections
Operators must hold prescribed operator certificates of competency
Rental company as 'designer, manufacturer or supplier' under Section 10: must ensure equipment is safe for intended use

equipment_inspection_and_certification.description: Explosion-protected apparatus for underground hazardous areas must be certified by SANAS-accredited test laboratory before deployment underground.
equipment_inspection_and_certification.authority: South African National Accreditation System (SANAS) — sanas.co.za
equipment_inspection_and_certification.applies_to: Battery LHDs, diesel equipment in UG mines, electrical apparatus in hazardous zones

equipment_inspection_and_certification.description: All equipment entering mine premises must be inspected and declared safe. Rental companies responsible for compliance before delivery. Inspection records to be maintained and available to Mine Safety Officers.
Heavy earthmoving equipment subject to periodic statutory inspections under OHS Act (General Machinery Regulations) and MHSA.

intervals.earthmoving_and_haul: Pre-shift inspection by competent operator; periodic maintenance inspection by qualified artisan
intervals.tyre_management: Regular inspection under MHSA for haul trucks

equipment_inspection_and_certification.description: All heavy earthmoving equipment operators must hold valid competency certificates. MHSA: certificates issued by Mine Health and Safety Inspectorate or TETA-accredited training body. OHS Act / Construction Regs: operator certificate for earthmoving machinery, cranes, forklifts.
equipment_inspection_and_certification.applies_to: Excavator, dozer, ADT, loader, grader, crane operators

equipment_inspection_and_certification.description: Haulage trucks, lowbeds and transport vehicles on public roads must hold valid roadworthy certificates (National Road Traffic Act). Abnormal load permits required for oversized equipment transport.
equipment_inspection_and_certification.applies_to: All road transport of heavy equipment

CIDB_registration.applicability: Required for contracts with public entities (state departments, SOEs, municipalities, state mining companies including AEMFC). Not mandatory for private-sector-only contracts.
relevant_work_classes: ME — Mechanical Engineering (equipment supply and maintenance)
documentation_required_grades_2_to_9: Copy of project award from client

bbbee_requirements.notes: B-BBEE level is a critical commercial requirement (not a legal operating requirement) for winning mining sector contracts. Most large mining houses require minimum Level 4; many prefer Level 1 or 2. PPPFA scoring: B-BBEE points contribute to supplier evaluation. Rham Equipment confirmed Level 3. Amandla Awethu Projects positions strongly on B-BBEE. MPRDA (Mineral and Petroleum Resources Development Act) requires Mining Charter compliance including supplier development and local procurement targets.
bbbee_requirements.mining_charter_III: Third Mining Charter (effective 2018, updated) requires mining companies to source 70% of goods from South African manufactured products, 80% of services from B-BBEE companies. Equipment rental companies with strong B-BBEE scores benefit directly.

additional_compliance.description: Valid Tax Clearance Certificate (or CSD compliance status pin) required for all state tender submissions and most large private-sector RFQs.
Company registration with Companies and Intellectual Property Commission. Annual returns must be current.

additional_compliance.requirement: COIDA — Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act
additional_compliance.description: Registration with Compensation Fund mandatory for all employers. Letter of Good Standing (LOGS) required for most tender submissions and on-site safety files.
Registration and monthly contribution mandatory for all employers.
Required by National Treasury for all entities bidding on government contracts. Used by Eskom, Transnet, AEMFC and state mining entities to verify suppliers. URL: secure.csd.gov.za
